subject: Post-demo follow-up: PII handling for prompts & outputs
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Chen <aaron.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-12-05T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: PII handling for prompts & outputs

Hi Aaron / Acme security team,

Thanks again for your time this morning — great discussion. Per our demo and to keep everything explicit, here’s a concise recap of what we covered and next steps on PII handling for prompts/outputs: 

What we discussed (high level)
- Hosted API: by default we retain request/response content for 30 days for abuse detection and troubleshooting.
- Training: Redwood does NOT use customer prompts/outputs to train public models unless the customer explicitly opts into a training program (opt-in only).
- Data residency: hosted data default to the region selected at account setup (US by default). We support EU residency on dedicated/private plans.
- Deletion: we provide an on-demand deletion API and admin console controls; standard deletion SLA for hosted customers is 24 hours from request for content removal from primary stores; complete purging from backups can take longer (documented).
- Encryption & keys: data at rest is encrypted; customer-managed KMS is available on Dedicated/Private.
- Dedicated/Private: Dedicated keeps logs within customer-dedicated GPU pools; Private (VPC/on-prem) keeps all logs under customer control.

Attachments: SOC2_report_redwood.pdf, data-handling-summary.pdf (attaching both for your security/compliance team).

Next steps we proposed
1) I’ll answer the specific questionnaire you sent and confirm the exact storage paths/retention windows for the endpoints you care about.
2) If you need 0-day retention for prompts/outputs on hosted, we can discuss a commercial opt-out (or move to Dedicated/Private where you control retention).
3) Neha (copied) from our compliance team will provide the formal wording for the DPA and confirm deletion SLA language.

Can you confirm the two most important items for you right now: 1) desired retention window (e.g., 30/90/0 days) and 2) whether you need explicit AWS region residency? Once I have that we’ll push a short written confirmation.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

From: Aaron Chen <aaron.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-12-05T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: PII handling for prompts & outputs

Thanks Rishi — helpful recap. A few clarifying questions from our security team: 

1) When you say "retain request/response content for 30 days", does that include the full prompt text and the model output (i.e., any PII that may be in either)?
2) Is the 30-day default applied to all hosted customers? Can we set 0-day retention (no content stored) for specific API keys or routes?
3) Are prompts/outputs included in telemetry/usage logs that are stored longer (billing, performance analytics)? If yes, where are those logs stored and for how long?
4) Can you confirm that customer prompts/outputs are not used to improve or fine-tune models unless we opt in? We need an explicit statement for procurement.
5) Data residency: we require AWS US-West-2 residency for initial pilots — can you confirm where the hosted data resides by default and whether we can pin region for production?
6) Deletion: we need an API that will remove prompts/outputs and a documented SLA (we prefer 24 hours for primary store removal). Can you confirm?

We attached our standard security questionnaire — please fill the sections related to data handling and retention.

Regards,
Aaron Chen
Security Engineering
Acme Health
security@acmehealth.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Chen <aaron.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-12-05T12:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: PII handling for prompts & outputs

Aaron — thanks for the detailed questions. Short answers below; Neha will follow with precise legal/compliance wording. I added a few links to our shared folder with SOC 2 material and the DPA template.

1) Does retention include full prompt/output? Yes — the "request/response content" phrase includes the prompt (request body) and model output. Those are what we retain under the default hosted setting.
2) 30-day default and per-key configuration: 30 days is our hosted default. For hosted customers we can offer a paid opt-out or per-key configuration (0 days) on certain plans. Dedicated/Private customers can set retention to 0 and keep control of storage.
3) Telemetry/logs: service telemetry (latency metrics, aggregated quotas) is kept separately and does not include full prompt/output content. Audit logs that include request/response snippets are subject to the same retention settings; billing records (token counts) are retained longer but do not contain prompt text.
4) Training: we do NOT use customer prompts/outputs to train models unless the customer explicitly opts in via a separate agreement. Procurement language: "Redwood will not use customer-provided prompts or outputs to train or improve models without explicit opt-in from the customer."
5) Residency: hosted accounts default to the region selected at signup. For pilots we can provision US-West-2. Production region pinning and EU residency are available on Dedicated/Private plans.
6) Deletion API & SLA: we provide a deletion API and admin console control. For hosted customers the usual SLA is 24 hours to remove primary store content; purge from backups may take up to 30 days depending on backup cycles.

Attachments: I filled the questionnaire sections we can answer now and re-attached SOC2 and our data-handling summary. See: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/acme/pii-handling-summary

If that lines up with your expectations, Neha will send the formal DPA language and a one-page confirmation you can attach to procurement.

Best,
Rishi

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Chen <aaron.chen@acmehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-12-05T15:27:00-08:00
Subject: Formal confirmation: PII handling (prompts & outputs) — technical and contractual details

Aaron / Acme security team,

Following up with the formal confirmation for procurement/security review. Below are explicit statements you can copy into your security questionnaire and procurement docs. If you need signed language, we will provide it in the DPA.

1) What is stored?
- For hosted API (default): full request and response payloads (including prompt text and model outputs) are stored in encrypted object stores for the configured retention period.
- For Dedicated: storage is within the dedicated customer environment; retention is configured per the customer's contract.
- For Private (VPC/on-prem): customer controls storage; Redwood does not retain copies.

2) Where is it stored?
- Hosted: region selected at account setup (US-West-2 available and can be provisioned for pilots). Storage is in our cloud provider's regional object storage controlled by Redwood; data-at-rest is encrypted.
- Dedicated/Private: per-customer environment/region.

3) How long is it retained?
- Hosted default: 30 days.
- Hosted opt-out: 0 days (no retention) available on select commercial terms and for specific API keys/routes.
- Dedicated/Private: configurable (we can meet 0-day retention or longer windows per contract).

4) Deletion and purge SLA
- Deletion API: immediate request acknowledgement.
- Primary store deletion SLA: standard hosted SLA is 24 hours for content removal from primary stores.
- Backup/replication purge: up to 30 days depending on backup retention windows; we document the backup schedule in the DPA.

5) Use for training or model improvement
- Redwood does not use customer prompts/outputs to train or improve public models unless the customer explicitly opts in via a documented agreement.

6) Access controls and encryption
- Data encrypted at rest and in transit.
- Access to hosted customer data is restricted to authorized Redwood personnel for SRE/support and on a least-privilege basis; access is logged and auditable.
- Customer-managed KMS is available on Dedicated/Private.

7) Audit evidence and compliance
- SOC 2 Type II report available (attached).
- We provide event-level audit logs and can deliver them via secure share for defined retention windows per contract.

If you need formalized language for procurement, we will provide a one-paragraph confirmation and include the DPA with the exact SLA and deletion language.

Let me know if there are any specific questionnaire items I should complete and I will return the filled document.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Aaron Chen <aaron.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-12-06T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Formal confirmation: PII handling (prompts & outputs) — technical and contractual details

Neha, Rishi — this is exactly the detail we needed. Thank you for the clear confirmation and the SOC2 attachments.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll attach the one-page confirmation to procurement and request an exception for the pilot in US-West-2.
- I’ve sent the remaining sections of our questionnaire; please complete the "access controls" and "backup/purge schedule" fields if possible.

If we need a tighter backup purge SLA or a written DPA clause, procurement will let you know. For now, this is sufficient to move to pilot.

Thanks again — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Aaron
